info.description: One product page under /solutions/<slug> (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, System Integrator).

legacySlug.description: Original Framer slug (e.g. "mnrl-—-mobile-network-revocation-list"), kept so old links can 301 to the new slug.

order.description: Sort position within its category on the Solutions listing page.

tagline.description: Short hero line under the title, e.g. "Revoke. Block. Protect. In Real Time."

whatIs.description: Body of the "What is <title>?" section. Heading is templated in code, not stored.

whyMatters.description: Body of the "Why Does It Matter?" section.

bestSuitedFor.description: Body of the "Best Suited For:" section.
